recipes.name: Angel Chicken Pasta
ingredients_raw: 1 (.7 ounce) package dry Italian-style salad dressing mix
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed golden mushroom soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Arrange chicken breasts in a single layer in a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Melt butter in a large saucepan over low heat. Stir in dressing mix, then stir in condensed soup and wine. Add cream cheese; cook and stir, without boiling, until smooth and heated through. Pour over chicken.

Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

About 15 minutes before the chicken is finished, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Add angel hair pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 4 to 5 minutes. Drain.
Serve chicken and sauce over pasta.

raw_recipe.headline: Angel Chicken Pasta
raw_recipe.description: This angel chicken dinner features boneless chicken baked in a mixture of condensed mushroom soup and cream cheese served over delicate angel hair pasta.

review.reviewBody:
My family loves this! The recipe I have is actually a slow cooker recipe and the ingredients are doubled as follows: 1/2 C butter, 2 pkgs dry italin dressing, 1 C white wine, 2 Cans golden mushroom soup, 8 oz tub cream cheese w/chives & onion.

Place chicken in slow cooker, pour melted ingredients over chicken, cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours.

I serve over penne pasta.

Wonderful easy dish that translates well to a slow cooker. Used 1 package of Garlic Herb Italian Dressig mix as that's all I had. Cut back on the butter to 1/8 cup. Added 1 tsp of minced garlic and 1 8oz package of mushrooms. Sauce was a little thinner that I anticipated, but nothing a nice golden roux couldn't correct!. This is a great recipe to make ahead or freeze: Prepare recipe as directed. Transfer to a 13- x 9-inch baking dish, and let cool completely. Can be frozen up to three months. Thaw before reheating. To reheat, cover tightly with aluminum foil, and bake at 325° for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Easy, uncomplicated, simple ingredients that will tantilize your tastebuds upon the first bite.
I have made this numerous times and it is Great every time!! I have done it in the slow cooker also, and that works if you are not going to be home until dinner. Love this!

This recipe is a hall-of-fame favorite for me and my family and friends. My recommendations after messing around with it a bit over the years: - Sauté mushrooms and scallions beforehand, then add the other ingredients, as instructed. This adds a bit more texture to the dish. - Chicken thighs (rather than breasts) reheat better and are super tender. In spite of other suggestions, I do NOT recommend cutting the chicken beforehand. Do it AFTER you take the dish out of the oven, then add it back to the sauce. The chicken will be MUCH more tender and juicy. - Angel pasta is probably the very last pasta I’d ever recommend with this dish. Try Campanelle and you won’t be sorry! It keeps its al dente texture far longer after adding to the sauce, and the shape of the pasta allows for the perfect ratio of sauce-to-pasta. - As others have said, DOUBLE it. Trust. The leftovers are as good as the fresh dish and you’ll want to be eating them for days! Enjoy! PS: This dish is great for camping, too. Just saute the chicken first, remove from pan, then make sauce. Add chicken back and let it simmer in the sauce to marry ingredients before serving. Goes great on bread!
Excellent recipe! Instead of the cream cheese with chive, I add Boursin shallot and chive cheese. I also add in mushrooms sometimes. Thanks for a GREAT recipe!

I've made it many times as is. It is 5 star.

Over time because my health needs have changed and I need to add more vegetables to my diet, I've added the following (all saute'd prior to adding to the sauce) - 1 8-ounce container of sliced mushrooms, 1/2 a head of small green cabbage, 1 small head of broccoli chopped up, and the full 0.75 ounce container of chives chopped. I also add 1 cup of cream to the sauce to cut the saltiness.

I make the sauce first (without adding the mushrooms), put the sauce and frozen chicken breasts into my Instapot with a 1/2 cup of chicken broth. It takes about 10 minutes on high pressure with a natural release. You need to make sure the chicken has sauce beneath it in the Instapot so that the chicken doesn't burn. If the chicken isn't cooked thru, put it back into the Instapot and add 3 minutes. Then I shred the chicken in my KitchenAid mixer with the bread paddle. Sauce and shredded chicken then get added to the cabbage, mushroom, and broccoli mixture I saute'd.

We have had this 3x so far last 6 weeks. Once with shrimp. I cut my chicken breasts in 2 inch chunks and velvet it for 20 minutes. Melt in your mouth. Cooked twice with Angel pasta, and last time with thin spaghetti. Just the two of us....ate on it for 3 days. You must have toasty garlic bread to soak up the sauce. My stomach is growling just thinking of this dish. 🥰

This has become one of my favorite chicken recipes. I make it exactly according to the recipe except I make it in a slow cooker. Just throw all the ingredients in (minus the pasta of course) and turn it on. So good!

Although I made a couple of additions, I still followed the recipe. I sauted some green pepper and onion in the saucepan before adding the rest of the sauce ingredients. I also used cream of chicken soup because that is what I had, and as suggested in other reviews, I doubled the sauce ingredients. What a fantastic dinner! I will definitely be making this again. I might try using chicken thighs next time. Only because the reheated breasts get kind of tough. I'm thinking that thighs might stay more tender. This is a very good recipe to play around with. I'm wondering about adding bacon, or chopped up artichoke hearts? Or different flavors of cream cheese? The recipe is 5 stars as written though. No need to do anything if you'd rather not.

I love this recipe, I cooked my chicken and sauce in a pressure cooker and it was amazing. I also added black olives, onions and tomatoes the second time I made it. I added the onions with the sauce and then 5 minutes before it was done I stopped the pressure cooker and added the tomatoes and olives then cooked for 5 more minutes. I'm in love with this recipe, thanks for sharing.

Even my kids will eat this one! We serve over rice instead of pasta, and I use chicken broth instead of wine. I also make this in the slow cooker - I just mix the ingredients together as directed and then pour over the chicken and cook it on low for 7 hours. Turns out great every time!
Do not take the time to make this recipe! It is B-O-R-I-N-G! For the various ingredients that go into it, it is bland with virtually no taste. Don’t waste your time!

Sounds and looks delicious! Seems like it would come together in a snap and be great for weeknights. Will be making for the family; unfortunately, the saturated fat and sodium content is too high for me.

This was too salty for me. I would make it again and use low sodium cream soup or make my own, and skip the salad dressing packet and just use herbs. I added a pack of fresh baby spinach at the end, and that worked out nicely.
So im not glutin free.But glutin free cambells is lighter tasting but gives the flavor. For those that dont like canned . I prefer chicken or golden mushroom.
No all good
Easy to make, maybe need a better cream of mushroom soup as the flavor was a little too much soup can flavor.
Great
I added chicken broth as well as the wine and spices. It was too bland for me.
Next time I would probably add a very small amt of olive oil and lemon
